findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Gate
Case: normal use - a developer generates a client from the committed OpenAPI file and runs the API locally. The changed `servers[0].url` points to `http://localhost:43017`, while the integration setup configures the API origin as `http://localhost:3000` and starts its test server on an ephemeral port. The generated client targets a port that will ordinarily be closed. The standards require API documentation to stay true to the running API.

findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 5, Harm 2
This change adds the contact API but no browser controls. The search result and member card buttons, safety reminder, same-tab navigation, unavailable-card alert, failed-press retry, and browser proof remain for T4B, which the supplied task guidance assigns to the web work.
